scroll.validate executes the seven-part completeness, exact quoted course span, changed exercise reference and independently checked solution gates in addition to schema/DAG/source/maths/mix.
Pattern cards teach If I see X -> try Y; pattern_drill asks recognition after the pattern is taught. Your exercises and generated variants require all supporting teaching parts and an eight-card lag.
CL pack actions require fresh source, review, validation and artifact checks; model generation still depends on the configured Luna runtime.
guidance: R2: >=50 percent graded cards are recall (flashcard/cloze/why/order/spot/faded worked); truefalse <=20 percent. No reward cards in packs.
Fact <=60 words; explainer <=120; reading <=40 seconds. Non-recap cards have source doc/span and stage/tier/run provenance.
Every prerequisite/tested concept has a teaching card. A graded card never teaches its tested concept.
Models: gpt-6-luna through T14 for wording/concepts/re-solve; gpt-6.1-sol only graph-sanity, worked-example, answer-dispute.
R14: worked all steps -> fade1 last step blank -> fade2 later half blank -> order/full problem. Keep the original answers.
Mistake catalogue: forgetting the inner derivative; multiplying derivatives in product rule; dropping a constant; sign inversion; confusing a converse; moving a step before its prerequisite.
fact examples: 'Slope is rise over run.'; 'A derivative is the slope of the tangent.'
explainer examples: 'Secant slopes tend to the tangent slope as the interval shrinks.'; 'The product rule differentiates one factor at a time and adds both changes.'
worked examples: 'Differentiate x^3: exponent 3 comes down, lower exponent to 2, obtain 3x^2.'; 'For x^2*exp(x), find 2x and exp(x), then add 2x*exp(x)+x^2*exp(x). Why: each factor changes.'
flashcard examples: front 'What is rise over run called?' back 'Slope.'; front 'Differentiate x^3.' back '3x^2.'
cloze examples: before 'Slope is ', blank 'rise over run', after '.'; before 'd/dx x^3 = ', blank '3x^2', after '.'
why examples: front 'Why multiply by the inner derivative?' back 'It accounts for the inner function changing.'; front 'Why does the product rule have two terms?' back 'Either factor can change.'
truefalse examples: 'The derivative of x^3 is 3x^2.' true with power-rule reason; 'The derivative of f*g is fprime*gprime.' false with both correct terms.

mcq examples: differentiate x^3 -> 3x^2 correct, x^2 wrong missing coefficient, 3x^3 wrong unchanged exponent; differentiate (3x+1)^2 -> 6(3x+1) correct, 2(3x+1) wrong missing inner derivative, 6x wrong lost inner expression.
order examples: power rule -> identify exponent, multiply coefficient, lower exponent; chain rule -> identify inner function, differentiate outer, multiply inner derivative.
spot examples: lines ['n=3','derivative=x^2'], wrong 1, fix 'derivative=3x^2'; lines ['u=3x+1','derivative=2u'], wrong 1, fix 'derivative=6u'.
recap examples: 'Slope: rise/run. Derivative: tangent slope.'; 'Product: fprime*g+f*gprime. Chain: outer derivative times inner derivative.'
